title: Mrs. Janice Bensadon: Emor & Behar- "How the Hagim and Shemita Ground us in Space and Time"

chapters.title: Introduction to Emor and Behar
chapters.about: Overview of the two Parashot and the transition from Mishkan-centered to nation-centered focus.

chapters.title: The Hagim and Shabbat
chapters.about: The significance of the repetition of the Hagim and the two categories of holidays.

chapters.title: Moedim as Meeting Times
chapters.about: The meaning of the word Moed as a fixed meeting time between Hashem and the nation.

chapters.title: The Solar and Lunar Calendar
chapters.about: The combination of solar and lunar cycles and their agricultural and historical significance.

summary: Mrs. Bensadon explores the connection between the Hagim and Shabbat in Parashat Emor and the laws of Shmita and Yovel in Parashat Behar. She explains how these designated times in the calendar serve as a meeting place between Hashem and the nation, encouraging us to pause our daily endeavors to foster a deeper relationship with Hashem and ourselves.
questions: Why are the Hagim and Shabbat repeated in Parashat Emor?
What is the significance of the Jewish calendar combining solar and lunar cycles?
How do Shmita and Yovel help us recognize that the land belongs to Hashem?
Why is it important to designate specific times for connection rather than just sharing space?
